sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri. M.B. Ryakha, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri. Vinay Mahadevaiah,
learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1, Smt. Haleema Ameen, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3. The charges are framed and the trial is on against these petitioners.

After the charges being framed and the trial being set into motion, the petitioners have filed the subject petition invoking the jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C.
4.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners NC: 2026:KHC:6737 HC-KAR submits that there is nothing that can be said to be a crime or ingredients of Section 498A of the IPC.
Since the charges are already framed, I declined to interfere at this stage of the proceedings.
However, the first petitioner, who is now aged 80 years shall be exempted from appearance before the Court unless situation warrants.
5. With the aforesaid observations, the petition stands disposed, reserving liberty to the petitioners to urge all the contentions before the concerned Court.

Sd/-
